import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
import numpy as np, json
from lib9 import *
allids=[r['id'] for r in practice()]; y=labels_for(allids, practice, LABELS); Y=np.eye(8)[y]
f=np.load('feats_drop46.npz'); M,C,M0=f['M'],f['C'],f['M0']
cp=np.load('carry_prov.npz'); wraw=cp['wraw'].astype(np.float64); mu0=cp['mu0'].astype(np.float64)
cold=(M0-mu0)@wraw; gM=carry_gain(M[:,RES],cold); gC=carry_gain(C[:,RES],cold)
tr=np.ones(1496,bool); c=20; cr=0.0; lam=.05; c0=.5
Lin=lin_feats(M0,tr); muK=M0[:,KEEP].mean(0); sn=np.sqrt(((M0[:,KEEP]-muK)**2).sum(1).mean())
print('lin_feats check', np.abs(Lin-(M0[:,KEEP]-muK)/sn).max())
mu=M.mean(0); Z=pool_z(M,C,c,mu,cr); Wd,Kaa,piv=prep_anchors(Z,tr)
Phi=feats(Z,Wd); coef,b=fit(Phi,Lin,Y,Kaa,lam,c0)
Wl=coef[1008:]; Wl_c=Wl-Wl.mean(1,keepdims=True)
Sl=Lin@Wl_c
lamb=np.sqrt((cold**2).sum()/(Sl**2).sum())
wnew=np.zeros((768,8)); wnew[KEEP]=lamb*Wl_c/sn
cnew=(M0-mu0)@wnew; print('cnew vs lamb*Sl', np.abs(cnew-lamb*Sl).max(), 'std old/new', cold.std(0).round(3), cnew.std(0).round(3))
Mn=M.copy(); Cn=C.copy(); Mn[:,RES]+=gM[:,None]*(cnew-cold); Cn[:,RES]+=gC[:,None]*(cnew-cold)
mun=Mn.mean(0); Zn=pool_z(Mn,Cn,c,mun,cr); Phin=feats(Zn,Wd)
print('Z KEEP change', np.abs(Zn[:,KEEP]-Z[:,KEEP]).max(), 'Phi change', np.abs(Phin-Phi).max())
L8=Zn[:,RES]-Zn[:,RES].mean(1,keepdims=True); Slc=Sl
beta=(L8*Slc).sum()/(L8**2).sum(); print('beta',beta, 'R2 L8->Sl', 1-((beta*L8-Slc)**2).sum()/(Slc**2).sum())
Sj=np.c_[Phi,Lin]@coef+b; Sk=Phin@coef[:1008]
Sdep=Sk+beta*L8+b
cen=lambda S:S-S.mean(1,keepdims=True)
print('train acc joint',(Sj.argmax(1)==y).mean(),'dep',(Sdep.argmax(1)==y).mean(), 'agree', (Sj.argmax(1)==Sdep.argmax(1)).mean())
srt=np.sort(Sdep,1); print('margin min/5pct', (srt[:,-1]-srt[:,-2]).min().round(4), np.percentile(srt[:,-1]-srt[:,-2],5).round(4))
print('centered score range', cen(Sdep).min().round(3), cen(Sdep).max().round(3), 'Zn RES std', Zn[:,RES].std().round(4))
np.savez('final_design.npz', coef=coef, b=b, Wd=Wd, piv=piv, wnew=wnew, mu0=mu0, mun=mun, mu=mu, beta=beta, lamb=lamb, c=c, cr=cr, Sdep=Sdep, Sj=Sj, Mn=Mn, Cn=Cn, gM=gM, gC=gC)
